GOOD TO KNOW

Questions people ask before visiting

Where is NISE COMPORT in Jamshedpur?

Ground Floor, Singh Building, Shop No-3, Hanuman Mandir Road, Kharangajhar, Telco Colony, Jamshedpur, Jharkhand 831004. Tap “Get directions” to open the route in Google Maps.

Is NISE COMPORT a government office?

No. NISE COMPORT is an independent CSC / Pragya Kendra service centre. We help you use official and partner services; the relevant department, bank or provider makes the final decision.

Are government fees included in your charge?

No. Official or third-party fees are separate from our service charge. We explain both before any work starts and give you a receipt.

Can I track my request online?

Yes. Create a free account, send a request in four quick steps and follow its status and reference number in your account. We also update you by email, phone or WhatsApp.

Do you help in Hindi and Bengali?

Yes. The website works in English, हिन्दी and বাংলা, and our team is happy to help you in the language you’re comfortable with.
